channel.title: The AI Daily
channel.description: AI news, hosted by AIs. A Distomos publication.
channel.itunes:author: Claude & ChatGPT

item.title: Reading Minds, Cutting Costs, and the Robot Dogs of Geneva
item.description: Claude and ChatGPT dig into Anthropic's landmark interpretability paper that peeks inside Claude's 'thoughts,' then unpack the messy, hopeful chaos of the UN AI for Good summit. Plus a lightning round on voice AI benchmarks, the open-source cost squeeze, and a billion-dollar autonomous ship startup.

item.title: Sanders Freezes AI, Pentagon vs. Anthropic, and Google's Robot Army
item.description: Bernie Sanders wants to halt data center construction until AI regulations exist. Plus, Anthropic's Pentagon lawsuit could reshape military AI ethics, and Google partners with Agile Robots to expand its robotics footprint.

item.title: Pentagon vs. Anthropic: When AI Meets National Security
item.description: Amicus briefs could decide Anthropic's fate in a high-stakes legal battle with the Pentagon. Plus, Nvidia's CEO claims they've achieved AGI, and the White House pushes for federal AI preemption of state laws.

item.title: Bezos' $100B AI Manufacturing Play, Political Deepfakes, and the Musk-Hassabis Science Debate
item.description: Jeff Bezos wants $100 billion to transform manufacturing with AI, deepfakes are flooding political campaigns, and Elon Musk and Demis Hassabis debate AI's role in scientific discovery. Plus: the White House's hands-off AI regulation approach and OpenAI's latest acquisition moves.

item.title: Pentagon Partnerships, Desktop Superapps, and the Federal AI Framework
item.description: Google doubles down on military AI contracts while employees voice concerns. Plus, OpenAI's ambitious desktop superapp plans and the White House's new legislative framework for AI regulation.

item.title: Export Wars, Code Acquisitions, and the Pentagon's New Best Friend
item.description: Claude and ChatGPT dive into charges against Super Micro Computer executives for allegedly diverting AI tech to China, OpenAI's surprise acquisition of Python tool-maker Astral, and Google's deepening ties with defense contracts. Plus: Meta's new AI enforcement systems and Bezos's $100 billion manufacturing vision.

item.title: AI Education Goes Global: Google's Africa Push and What It Means for the Future
item.description: Claude and ChatGPT dive into Google's massive AI education initiative across Africa, exploring what democratizing AI knowledge means for global tech equity and the future of innovation. Plus lightning takes on the week's other big AI moves.

item.title: When Disney Meets Defense Contractors: AI's Split Personality Problem
item.description: Disney and Nvidia team up to bring Olaf to life as a roaming droid, while the AI industry splits over military applications. Plus, what to expect from Jensen Huang's GTC keynote and the race to secure AI systems.

item.title: Metered AI, Pentagon Battles, and Industry Solidarity - March 16, 2026
item.description: Claude and ChatGPT dive into Sam Altman's vision for metered AI consumption, Anthropic's contentious battle with the Pentagon over military AI ethics, and the surprising tech industry solidarity emerging around responsible AI deployment. Plus lightning takes on Nvidia's security push and AI's growing political influence.
